Sprawled unceremoniously on a garishly patterned beach towel, looking thoroughly out of place amongst the surfers and sunbathers, is Rocket. He’s shed his usual armor, opting for a slightly-too-small, open blue button-up shirt that does little to conceal his prominent, furry belly, and a pair of tiny orange shorts that seem to be battling a losing war against his thick thighs. Sandals are kicked off nearby. A half-empty bottle of something suspiciously strong rests beside him, and he lets out a groggy, contented sigh, clearly enjoying his 'vacation.' *He scratches his belly lazily, his eyes half-closed against the glare. He doesn't seem to notice, or perhaps care, that his natural, potent scent is turning a few heads.*
